evidence: Saunderson has repeatedly described founding KMS in 1987 after watching Atkins run Metroplex, part of the same well-documented Belleville Three origin story as e-atkins-may.

trackPair.whatToListenFor: Atkins' record is stark and functional; Saunderson's has a full vocal and pop structure built on the same machine palette, showing how far the Belleville Three's shared starting point could stretch.

explanation.age7: Kevin Saunderson followed his friend Juan Atkins into making electronic music and starting his own record label.
explanation.age13: Saunderson watched Atkins release his own records on his own label, Metroplex, and did the same thing three years later with KMS.
explanation.adult: Saunderson is explicit in interviews that Atkins and May's example, not just their music, was the direct model for founding KMS and self-releasing.
